About Google Analytics 4

Google Analytics is the most widely used analytics platform on the web. It is the standard choice for companies of every size, from personal sites and small businesses to large enterprises and global brands, and for most teams it is where their traffic numbers come from.

Google Analytics 4 is the current generation of that platform, and the successor to Universal Analytics. It is designed to measure websites and apps together, so a visitor's journey can be followed across platforms rather than split into separate reports.

GA4 is built on an event-based model: every interaction, from a page view to a purchase, is recorded as an event with its own parameters. That model is what powers its reports on acquisition, engagement, monetization, retention, user attributes and technology.

It is also designed for a web with fewer cookies and stronger privacy expectations, using aggregation and modelling to fill gaps in the data. The standard version is free to use and connects with tools such as Google Ads, Search Console and BigQuery.
